methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date; per-seat/per-user tiers record the per-user monthly price with a note, while flat per-account tiers are marked billingModel flat. Where a provider quotes only the annual-billing monthly rate, that figure is recorded with annualDiscountPct null; Dropbox Sign's promo-discounted annual rate is noted rather than treated as the standard discount. Quote-only Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every plan since they do not apply to e-signature. Adobe Acrobat Sign prices were corroborated against multiple 2026 pricing sources because adobe.com timed out repeatedly via fetch.

vendors.name: DocuSign
vendors.provenance: https://ecom.docusign.com/plans-and-pricing/esignature (official eSignature plans page, accessed 2026-06-13; prices shown are annual-billing-billed-monthly rates)

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: Single user, 5 envelopes per month. $11/month on annual billing ($132/year). Reusable templates, AI-assisted summary, 1000+ integrations.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Per-user/month ($30/user/mo annual, $360/year per user). 100 envelopes per user per year. Adds shared templates, real-time commenting, custom branding, one-time bonus of 5 SMS deliveries and 5 ID verifications.

plans.name: Business Pro
plans.notes: Per-user/month ($45/user/mo annual, $540/year per user). 100 envelopes per user per year. Adds mobile-friendly web forms, payment collection during signing, interactive form fields, bulk send.

plans.name: Enhanced Plans (Enterprise)
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales. Custom envelope limits, centralized management, 24/7 support, SSO, Salesforce integration.

plans.name: Starter

plans.name: Business

plans.name: Enterprise

plans.name: Essentials

plans.name: Standard

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Quote-only (large teams, 5+ users). Unlimited users, advanced signer fields & tools, advanced reporting, data residency options, multi-team support, performance dashboards.
